factory_fit_checkpoint.mission: Protects research truth before entity evidence can affect holder risk or eligibility.
factory_fit_checkpoint.flexibility: Raw nodes and edges remain stable while candidate rules and providers can version independently.
factory_fit_checkpoint.compatibility_history: Adopts TASK-05 and TASK-11 contracts without rewriting their evidence.
factory_fit_checkpoint.efficiency: Uses declarative files and tables; no graph database or new dependency.
factory_fit_checkpoint.research_truth: Freezes PIT, provenance, conflict, blinding and no-hindsight rules before value reads.
factory_fit_checkpoint.owner_operability: Returns one of four explicit owner decisions and exposes NOT_TESTABLE rather than false certainty.
factory_fit_checkpoint.execution_to_cashflow: Makes no alpha, execution, PnL, NetReturn or cashflow claim.
factory_fit_checkpoint.monitoring_recovery: Append-only revisions and conflict sets preserve rollback and auditability.
factory_fit_checkpoint.build_vs_buy: ADOPT schema and evidence semantics; WRAP a thin graph contract; no vendor or graph platform added.
factory_fit_checkpoint.red_team: Common funders, fee payers, vendor labels and missing data are explicitly blocked from silent ownership promotion.

now.value: Prevents false wallet linkage from contaminating adjusted concentration and downstream research.
now.evidence: TASK-11 has only raw top-20 feasibility; deployer, funder and bundler evidence is NOT_TESTED.
now.cost_risk: Four local files, no value read, no external action.
now.why_now: The contract must precede the first entity-value read.

watch.value: Reduces asset-registration drift when TASK-24 outputs become durable.
watch.evidence: TASK-23 closed with Catalog 0.28.0 and generated consumers; no TASK-24 asset exists yet.
watch.cost_risk: Small validation hardening only if A5 registers new assets.
watch.why_not_now: A2 creates a contract checkpoint, not the final asset set.
